integrity: Mathematical derivations are supplied in RESULT.md and a supplementary reproducible checker.py; no external or independent review has taken place.
scientific_limitations: All asserted operator norms are on the real Banach space of Hermitian matrices; no norm equality is asserted for arbitrary complex matrices or completely bounded extensions. Product-state extremality is a proof, not an independent certification. The claim covers finite tensor products and all real weights. Some equivalent noncommutative conditional-expectation reformulation may remain uncatalogued.
title: Exact Hermitian norms of weighted one-body marginal projections
